WITH pkg AS (
  SELECT file_id FROM code.files
  WHERE package = 'auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo' AND NOT is_test
), syms AS (
  SELECT s.symbol_id, s.kind, s.name, s.qualname
  FROM code.symbols s JOIN pkg p ON s.file_id = p.file_id
  WHERE s.is_public AND s.name NOT LIKE '\_%' ESCAPE '\'
), classified AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN kind = 'class' AND qualname NOT LIKE '%.%' THEN 'class'
    WHEN kind = 'function' AND qualname NOT LIKE '%.%' THEN 'function'
    WHEN kind = 'method' THEN 'method'
  END AS kind
  FROM syms
)
SELECT kind, COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS public_count
FROM classified
WHERE kind IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY kind
ORDER BY kind

request:
How many public classes, public module-level functions and public methods are defined in the non-test code of the auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/ package (files under its tests/ folder excluded)? A name is public when it does not start with an underscore, so dunder methods such as __init__ are not public, and methods of a class whose name starts with an underscore are not public either. Nested functions and nested classes are not counted. Return one row per kind, with kind being 'class', 'function' or 'method'.

Requested output columns: kind (string), public_count (integer).
explanation: Restricts to non-test files in the auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo package, keeps public symbols whose names don't start with an underscore, and classifies them as class, function, or method based on kind and whether the qualname is top-level. Nested classes/functions (qualnames containing a dot) are excluded, and counts are grouped by kind.
sql:
WITH pkg AS (
  SELECT file_id FROM code.files
  WHERE package = 'auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo' AND NOT is_test
), syms AS (
  SELECT s.symbol_id, s.kind, s.name, s.qualname
  FROM code.symbols s JOIN pkg p ON s.file_id = p.file_id
  WHERE s.is_public AND s.name NOT LIKE '\_%' ESCAPE '\'
), classified AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN kind = 'class' AND qualname NOT LIKE '%.%' THEN 'class'
    WHEN kind = 'function' AND qualname NOT LIKE '%.%' THEN 'function'
    WHEN kind = 'method' THEN 'method'
  END AS kind
  FROM syms
)
SELECT kind, COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS public_count
FROM classified
WHERE kind IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY kind
ORDER BY kind
